title: Migrate an NgDoc project to the Vite engine

project.description: The project to migrate. Defaults to the only project that builds with @ng-doc/builder:application.

revert.description: Undo an earlier migration of the project: restore its original targets and changed files, and delete the files the migration created.

viteConfig.description: The Vite configuration file to create, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to vite.config.mjs in the project root.

rootComponent.description: The file of the application's root component, relative to the workspace root. Found from the browser entry by default.

skipInstall.description: Do not install the added dependencies.
